title: Danger
summary: DANGER, noun Peril; risk; hazard; exposure to injury, loss, pain or other evil. Our craft is in danger to be set at nought. Acts 19:27. It is easy to boast of despising death, when there is no danger

inlines.v: DANGER, noun Peril; risk; hazard; exposure to injury, loss, pain or other evil. Our craft is in danger to be set at nought. Acts 19:27. It is easy to boast of despising death, when there is no danger DANGER, verb transitive To put in hazard; to expose to loss or injury.
